# Motion 8 Agency

> Growth infrastructure — every stage, every size. One accountable team across software development, AI & automation, and digital marketing. Operating across India, USA, and UAE.

## About
Motion 8 Agency builds the software, AI systems, and marketing engines that funded startups need to scale. Instead of juggling a dev shop, an AI consultancy, and a marketing agency, Motion 8 provides one accountable team with shared context on product, systems, and demand.

- Website: https://motion8agency.co
- Email: hello@motion8agency.co
- Locations: India · USA · UAE
- Founded: 2024
- Target Audience: Seed to Series B+ funded startups and high-growth companies

- URL: https://motion8agency.co/local-business-website-bundle

- Deliverables:
  1. Handcrafted Next.js 15 Website (5-7 custom pages, sub-second edge load speed, 95+ Core Web Vitals)
  2. Complete On-Page Local SEO (meta tags, Open Graph cards, dynamic sitemap, robots directives)
  3. Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) schema for voice assistants (Siri, Alexa, Google) and conversational AI (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google Gemini)
  4. Brand Identity Suite (custom vector logo, complete brand guidelines, typography, color palette)
  5. Lifetime Free Global CDN Hosting with automated SSL encryption ($0/mo forever)
